card.name: Linking words before placebo-controlled trials
card.fires_on: The word "from" after "substantial evidence" and the word "these" after "In", in antidepressant suicidality warnings. Both come just before "placebo-controlled" or "trials".

modes.label: evidence from
modes.description: "from" right after "substantial evidence" in the longer-term suicidality risk passage, before placebo-controlled maintenance studies.
modes.example: However, there is substantial evidence<< from>> placebo-controlled maintenance studies in adults with depression

modes.label: In these trials
modes.description: "these" after "In" at the start of a sentence that refers back to the trials just described.
modes.example: 8, 95% CI:1.2, 2.7) of suicidal thinking or behavior compared to patients randomized to placebo. In<< these>> trials, which had a median treatment duration

card.writes: No clear link to the listed tokens, which look unrelated and uninformative.
card.plain: It marks the small word that introduces antidepressant trial evidence in suicidality warnings.
